name: Vimutti Monastery
retreatOptions: 3 days to 1 week typical first stay; periodic organized retreats (e.g. New Year)
about: A 72-144 acre forest monastery run by the Auckland Theravada Buddhist Association. The monastery's own materials note it is not designed as a self-contained lay retreat program -- guests join the full monastic routine and daily work rather than a packaged retreat -- though it does host periodic structured retreats and welcomes overnight lay stays; included here as a monastic-immersion option rather than a packaged lay retreat.
schedule: Periodic organized retreats; open-ended guest stays otherwise
workNotes: Daily work required as part of monastic routine.
